rows.question: Nawa ne buhun shinkafa?
rows.reply: Jakunkin shinkafa (50 kg) yana da farashin ₦82,000.
rows.english: A bag of rice (50 kg) costs ₦82,000.

rows.question: Nawa ne buhun wake?
rows.reply: Jaka na wake farashin ₦95,000.
rows.english: A bag of beans costs ₦95,000.

rows.question: Yaushe kuke buɗe shago?
rows.reply: Muna buɗe daga ƙarfe 8 na safe zuwa 6 na yamma, Litinin zuwa Asabar.
rows.english: We open from 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.

rows.question: Ina shagonku yake?
rows.reply: Shagonmu yana cikin shago na 12, kasuwar Dawaki.
rows.english: Our shop is located at Shop 12, Dawanau market.

rows.question: Nawa ne buhun masara?
rows.reply: Farashin masara (jaka 100kg) ba a sanya shi ba tukuna. Da fatan za a duba da mai gidan domin samun karin bayani.
rows.english: The price for maize (bag 100 kg) is not set yet. Please check with the owner for details.

rows.question: Elo ni àpò ìrẹsì?
rows.reply: Iye owo fun apo iresi ti o wu 50 kg jẹ ₦82,000.
rows.english: The price for a 50 kg bag of rice is ₦82,000.

rows.question: Elo ni àpò ẹ̀wà?
rows.reply: A kò ní iye owó tí wọ́n ṣètò fún ohun yẹn. Mo nilo lati kan si oniwun fun o.
rows.english: We don't have a set price for that item. I will need to check with the owner for you.

rows.question: Ìgbà wo ni ẹ máa ń ṣí ṣọ́ọ̀bù?
rows.reply: A ṣí láti 8 àárọ̀ sí 6 irọ̀lẹ̀, Mọ́ńdé sí Sátidé.
rows.english: We open from 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.

rows.question: Níbo ni ṣọ́ọ̀bù yín wà?
rows.reply: Ibi itaja wa ni ile itaja 12, oja Dawanau.
rows.english: Our shop is located at Shop 12, Dawanau market.

rows.question: Elo ni àpò àgbàdo?
rows.reply: Iye apo iresi ko tii ṣeto sibẹsibẹ; a nilo lati kan si oniwun naa.
rows.english: The price for a bag of maize is not set yet; we will need to check with the owner.

rows.question: Ego ole ka akpa osikapa bụ?
rows.reply: Akpa osikapa (50 kg) na-efu ₦82,000.
rows.english: A bag of rice (50 kg) costs ₦82,000.

rows.question: Ego ole ka akpa agwa bụ?
rows.reply: Ndo, anyị enweghị ego maka akpa poteto. M ga-achọkwa ikwu okwu na onye nwe ya maka gị.
rows.english: I’m sorry, we don’t have a price for a bag of potatoes. I will need to check with the owner for you.

rows.question: Kedu oge unu na-emeghe ụlọ ahịa?
rows.reply: Anyị na-emeghe site n’elekere 8 nke ụtụtụ ruo 6 nke mgbede, Mọnde ruo Satọdee.
rows.english: We are open from 8 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday.

rows.question: Ebee ka ụlọ ahịa unu dị?
rows.reply: Ụlọ ahịa anyị dị na nọmba ụlọ 12, ahịa Dawanau.
rows.english: Our shop is located at Shop 12, Dawanau market.

rows.question: Ego ole ka akpa ọka bụ?
rows.reply: Ndo, ego maka akpa nke ọka adịghị edozi ya. Biko lelee onye nwe ya maka ọnụahịa dị ugbu a.
rows.english: Sorry, the price for a bag of maize is not set yet. Please check with the owner for the current price.

rows.question: How much be one bag of rice?
rows.reply: One bag of rice (50 kg) dey cost ₦82,000.
rows.english: One bag of rice (50 kg) costs ₦82,000.

rows.question: How much una dey sell beans bag?
rows.reply: One 100 kg bag of beans dey cost ₦95,000.
rows.english: A 100 kg bag of beans costs ₦95,000.

rows.question: Wetin be una opening time?
rows.reply: We dey open from 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.
rows.english: We open from 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.

rows.question: Where una shop dey?
rows.reply: Our shop dey for Shop 12, Dawanau market.
rows.english: Our shop is at Shop 12, Dawanau market.

rows.question: How much be maize bag?
rows.reply: I no get price for maize bag yet; I go need check with the owner.
rows.english: I no get price for maize bag yet; I go need check with the owner.
